content.title: OS - Top OS Features
content.text: OS Overview Stunning design.Stellar experiences. Introducing our broadest design update ever, a more helpful Apple Intelligence, and exciting features available on iOS 26, iPadOS 26, macOS Tahoe, watchOS 26, visionOS 26, and tvOS 26. Watch the event Get the highlights. Design Beautiful, delightful, and familiar across your devices. A new design with Liquid Glass brings hardware and software together like never before, so everything you do feels more vibrant and expressive — yet instantly familiar. Watch the film Apple Intelligence Smarter in even more places. Apple Intelligence is integrated into even more places to help you communicate across languages, create more personal images, and get more done.7 Communication Goodbye distractions. Hello meaningful interactions. From voice to text to video, there are more ways than ever to express yourself. And new features give you more power to reduce interruptions. Productivity Do it all. A whole lot easier. Discover handy new tools to help you stay organized, supercharge workflows, and make quick work of almost any task. Discovery Go all out. Take it all in. Tap into new ways to discover the world and navigate with ease. Get real-time information when you need it most. And enjoy more immersive entertainment on the go. There’s even more in store. There’s plenty to love for developers, too. Learn more
